title: OWL inference
question: Which documents are HCP sentiment studies, although no document is stored with that type?
sparql:
PREFIX Watson: <http://watson.local/pharma#>
PREFIX rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
SELECT ?document ?title ?state
WHERE {
  ?document a Watson:HCPSentimentStudy ;        # stored type is Watson:HCPPerceptionSurvey, a subclass
            Watson:documentTitle ?title ;
            Watson:lifecycleState ?state .
}
ORDER BY ?document
